title: Thm lower Step A: r^off>=2 does NOT yield an ordinary-ordinary 2x2 minor (uses false eq:roffeqLam)

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Theorem `lower` Step A cannot extract the required ordinary--ordinary $2\times2$ minor from $r_m^{\mathrm{off}}\ge2$.**

Thm `lower` Steps B,C need a nonzero $2\times2$ minor whose **two column triples $c,c'$ are both ordinary**: $R^{(c)}$ has rank $4$ only for ordinary $c$ (eq:G1), and Step C's eigenspace-splitting argument needs $\dim V_c=\dim V_{c'}=4$. Step A obtains such a minor from
$$r_1^{\mathrm{off}}\ge2 \overset{\text{eq:roffeqLam}}{\Longrightarrow} \operatorname{rank}\Lambda'\ge2,$$
which is exactly the **false** implication of q9-12.

**Counterexample (verified, $n=5$).** For the $\lambda$ of q9-12: $r_1^{\mathrm{off}}=5\ge2$, yet $\operatorname{rank}\Lambda'^{(1)}=1$, so mode $1$ has **no** ordinary--ordinary $2\times2$ minor. Step A's extraction fails in mode $1$.

**What is actually provable.** The version
$$\operatorname{rank}\Lambda'^{(m)}\ge2\ \Longrightarrow\ \operatorname{rank}\mathbf S_{(m)}\ge5$$
**is** correct (this is what Steps B,C really prove). So Thm `lower` should be **restated** with hypothesis $\operatorname{rank}\Lambda'^{(m)}\ge2$, and the *necessity chain* must then be re-derived from this corrected statement (see the local-to-global companion issue), not from $r_m^{\mathrm{off}}\ge2$. Also: Steps B (eq:G1) and C need explicit non-vanishing witnesses (cf. q9-10/q9-11).
